method: Continuous major-cue baseline with attack onsets restricted to ±25ms, selected set-piece accents, and monotone cubic animation-time conform. Music remains unaltered at 1×; ordinary attacks cannot reset back to the unshifted clock after a story cue.
tempo_note: Tempo candidates vary across sections; no claim of an exact steady 168 BPM. Matching uses onset landmarks rather than a global BPM assumption.
